title: RISE Live: astronomy in Sophia's circle, one photograph per scene, and a paused reading takes a named visual
acceptance: Where the face draws, a collection photograph is held in the shell, Sophia's circle, in both rooms, covering it like a porthole; its credit (title, makers, licence) is a caption under the circle that opens with it and never meets the words. Where the face does not draw, it is hung in the safe rectangle as before.

A collection shows one photograph while its scene is on screen: the Gallery does not move on when its pool merely warms or a prepared cue is admitted (no flash to another work and back). A change of scene still moves it.

Words that only name a visual ('astronomy') show it at once whether the reading is playing or paused; in a paused reading the reading plays on, as Play would. Before a reading and after one they are still a question.

evidence.note: The owner, on the deployed room: 'astronomy' sometimes switched the picture and sometimes started a reading about astronomy; the picture went Jupiter, a nebula for a moment, Jupiter again; the photograph filled the room; it should sit in the outer shell, framed by Sophia's circle.

Branch live-astro-shell. New tests failed first on the old code: the Gallery wake moved Jupiter to the nebula (continuous-field.test.js); a paused reading's 'astronomy' became a new reading (venue.test.js) and chooseVisual refused a paused reading (runtime.catalog.test.js). npx vitest run src/live/host src/scenes src/visuals/continuous-field.test.js src/live/runtime.catalog.test.js src/live/catalog-words.test.js src/live/boundary.test.js: 25 files, 853 passed; continuous-field and visual-cortex: 221 passed.

Agent observation, not a human's: the dev server at 1440x900 and 390x844, dark and light rooms. Sampled every 50 ms for 9 s after 'astronomy': before, one work, a crossfade to another 0.65 s later and back at 8.9 s; after, one work throughout. The photograph fills the shell; the caption sits 9 px clear of the words on desktop and 57 px on the phone.

activity.summary: Created from the owner's trial of the deployed astronomy slice; built on branch live-astro-shell. Not merged, not deployed, not accepted by a human.

summary: Astronomy held in Sophia's circle with its credit under it, one photograph per scene (the Gallery no longer skips on a wake), and a paused reading takes a named visual instead of starting a new one.
